item.title: MirrorCam 1.4.0
item.description: - Mirror is now MirrorCam, with a new icon and wordmark (mirror.cam) - The window always keeps your camera's shape (any size you like), so there are no black bars and the soft light is even all around - Click anywhere in the mirror to show the controls; drag to move the window - Help → Send Feedback… writes the email for you (version, settings, recent activity; nothing personal) - Settings and About use your Mac's accent color and open in front
